posts.text:
Would You Trust AI to Service Your Mortgage Notes? Pros, Cons, & Pitfalls

http://WeCloseNotes.com

Can artificial intelligence really replace human loan servicers when a mortgage goes into default, or is handing your note portfolio over to an algorithm a recipe for disaster? Welcome back to The Note Closers Show! 

In this episode, Scott Carson evaluates the state of 100% AI-driven loan servicing following a 30-minute demonstration with a leading fintech servicing provider. While AI excels at streamlining automated tasks for performing paper—such as generating monthly billing statements, updating payment methods, sending automated text pings, and onboarding loan documents—it falls short when managing non-performing mortgages.
